question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'called.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 called 
 to give someone or something a name, or to know or address someone by a particular name
 
 

 labelled 
 a piece of writing or material that gives you information
 
 

 described
 to give a written or spoken report of how something is done or of what someone or something is like
 
 

 identified
 to recognize someone or something and say or prove who or what that person or thing is
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that desert locust move together in huge numbers and their group is collectively addressed as swarms.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "called."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Complete passage:__ *Swarms of the desert locust, which invaded India via Pakistan in April, have made __(1) their__ way to at least five states, (__2) leaving__ a trail of destruction in their (__3) wake__. Desert locusts move in large groups, (__4) called__ swarms, and can eat crops up (__5) to__ their own weight every day. When millions of __(6) locusts__ descend on a crop, they destroy __(7) everything__. The desert locust is considered the __(8) most__ destructive migratory pest in the world __(9) since__ a single swarm covering one square kilometre can __(10) contain__ up to 80 million locusts. As per eyewitnesses, the swarm which entered India from Pakistan was about two to three kilometres long.*
